question: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?

details.reason: Complete results match Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 1.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN gs.country = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN gs.country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discount_diff_cze_minus_svk
FROM gasstations gs
WHERE LOWER(gs.segment) = 'discount';
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM gasstations WHERE segment = 'Discount'
